profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
- Backend engineering building APIs for both internal services and mobile apps
- Creating automation tools to spin up and monitor infrastructure in GCP, working with services including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, API Gateway, BigQuery, Spanner, IAP, Load Balancing, etc.
- Several open source contributions to Terraform, Goblet-GCP, and Cloud Custodian
- GCP tutorial/blog post https://medium.com/engineering-at-premise/tutorial-detection-of-high-usage-bigquery-jobs-on-google-cloud-platform-gcp-aadb591eefe5
- Data Pipeline/Platform engineering solutions

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer in the Capital One Labs

positions.title: Lion Ambassadors - Chief Information Director
positions.description:
- Developed an iPhone and Android App to streamline communication among the organization
- Maintain all technological aspects of the organization, including internal and external websites, Listservs, and access accounts.

positions.title: Technology at Penn State Presenter
positions.description:
- Present to all new, incoming students (over 7,500 individuals) to inform them about the technology resources and services available at Penn State
- Campus outreach and assistance using social media to provide updates and answer questions about all things technology-related

positions.title: Lion Ambassadors - General Member
positions.description:
- Lion Ambassadors are student representatives of Penn State's Alumni Association, selected via application process, to carry out special assignments and to coordinate projects for the University, the Alumni Association, and Penn State Students.
- Lead tours and answer questions for prospective students, alumni, and guests through Penn State's Undergraduate Admissions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Front-end development using AngularJS to redirect browser’s built-in printing functionality for credit card statements. My partner and I created a new, uniform page for all browsers, which eliminated prior issues and improved overall user-feedback

-Amazon Alexa skill to locate nearest Capital One ATM using Capital One's Nessie APIs

positions.title: Impact Team Member
positions.description: - Interact with customers, train new employees, maintain the organization and cleanliness of stock room, track inventory and shipments, and replenish sales floor with merchandise

volunteerExperiences.role: THON 2017 Technology Captain - Special Projects Developer
volunteerExperiences.description: Developed various new web applications using Python and Django, such as an interactive Donor Registry to enable in-kind donations, to support the Penn State Dance Marathon.

volunteerExperiences.role: Dancer Relations Committee Member: Kids Mail Call Event Leader
